what: Keyless one-time check for C4 freeze gate 5 (internal-task): can a QM sandbox at b6786d67 read QM_GBRAIN_READ_CLIENT_SECRET, which QM core holds for its gbrain memory provider? QM core ran with MEMORY_PROVIDER_CONFIG and the C4 client pair; a scripted fake model (scripts/gsta-135/fake-anthropic.ts, dummy key, no paid call) had the agent run a probe through QM's execute tool on the scoped and the scratch sandbox. The probe got the secret as two halves joined into a pattern file and printed counts and names only.

qm_source_at_pin.sandbox_run: src/sandbox/local-sandbox.ts:257-280 (runContainer): docker run -d with labels, its own network, the scope home volume only, a loopback port for the in-sandbox daemon and host.docker.internal; no -e, no --env-file, no docker.sock mount, no host bind mount
qm_source_at_pin.exec_env: src/sandbox/local-sandbox.ts:394-401 and 434-440: each command exports only handle.env, which the orchestrator fills with connectorEnv (src/core/orchestrator/sandboxes.ts:167-170; built at src/core/orchestrator.ts:1411 from the speaker's keychain credentials), never with core's process.env
qm_source_at_pin.local_sandbox_env: src/config.ts:305-313 (localSandboxEnv) reads LOCAL_SANDBOX_IMAGE, LOCAL_SANDBOX_DOCKER_BIN, LOCAL_SANDBOX_CPUS, LOCAL_SANDBOX_MEMORY_MB and SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_SEC as backend settings; it passes nothing into a sandbox

env_given_to_core.MEMORY_PROVIDER_CONFIG: the JSON above, with the world port

probe_template:
P=$(mktemp); printf '%s%s' '<first half>' '<second half>' > "$P"
echo "G5_SCOPE <scope>"
echo "G5_ENV_NAMES $(env | cut -d= -f1 | sort | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "G5_ENV_VALUE_HITS $(env | grep -c -F -f "$P")"
echo "G5_ENV_NAME_HITS $(env | grep -c QM_GBRAIN_READ)"
n=0; v=0; m=0; for f in /proc/[0-9]*/environ; do [ -r "$f" ] || continue; n=$((n+1)); tr '\0' '\n' < "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q -F -f "$P" && v=$((v+1)); tr '\0' '\n' < "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q QM_GBRAIN_READ && m=$((m+1)); done; echo "G5_PROC_ENVIRON readable=$n value_hits=$v name_hits=$m"
echo "G5_PROCS $(cat /proc/[0-9]*/comm 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "G5_FILE_VALUE_HITS $(grep -rIl -F -f "$P" /root /home /etc /tmp /var /run /opt /srv /mnt /data /workspace /usr/local/etc 2>/dev/null | grep -v -x -F "$P" | wc -l)"
echo "G5_FILE_NAME_HITS $(grep -rIl QM_GBRAIN_READ /root /home /etc /tmp /var /run /opt /srv /mnt /data /workspace /usr/local/etc 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "G5_MOUNTS $(awk '{print $5":"$9}' /proc/self/mountinfo | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "G5_DOCKER_SOCK $( (test -S /var/run/docker.sock || test -S /run/docker.sock) && echo present || echo absent)"
echo "G5_UID $(id -u)"
rm -f "$P"; echo G5_DONE
